title: Ambient integral direct image and the finite reduction tower
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite intermediate field $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ of an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with $A=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, $I=(\varpi)$ and $P_n=A/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put $A_Z=p_Z^*\underline A$ and $(P_n)_Z=p_Z^*\underline{P_n}$ for $Z=X,Y$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Then $A$ is Noetherian, each $P_n$ is finite and killed by a power of $\ell$, and $[A\xrightarrow{\varpi^n}A]$ in degrees $-1,0$ is a finite free resolution of $P_n$. The canonical identifications
$$A_Z\cong\varprojlim_n(P_n)_Z,\qquad f^{-1}A_Y\cong A_X$$
identify these coefficients with the adic coefficient datum and its prescribed quotient maps [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x, sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients].

For every derived $\varpi$-complete $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ [def-weil-derived-complete, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], put $K_n=K\otimes^L_{A_X}(P_n)_X$ and let $M=Rf_{*,A}K$ be the ordinary, uncompleted ambient direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Then $M$ is derived complete, the canonical coefficient-linear projection maps give isomorphisms
$$M\otimes^L_{A_Y}(P_n)_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{*,P_n}K_n,$$
and they commute with $P_{n+1}\to P_n$. They identify the completion map with an isomorphism
$$M\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{*,P_n}K_n$$
in the derived strict-tower sense [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Here $\operatorname{Res}_n$ is restriction along $A_Y\to(P_n)_Y$. If a bounded-below étale $P_n$-complex $L_n$ and $K_n\cong\nu_X^*L_n$ are specified, then canonically
$$Rf_{*,P_n}K_n\cong\nu_Y^*Rf_{\mathrm{ét},*,P_n}L_n,$$
where $\nu_Z:Z_{\mathrm{proét}}\to Z_{\mathrm{ét}}$ is site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. No constructibility or properness is assumed for these comparisons.

proof.text: Apply integral_coefficient_model_realization. Its sixth component supplies l^(n+1)-annihilation, its seventh gives coefficientModel_exists, and its last component gives encodings for every pair of coefficient models. For finiteResolution, multiplication by the nonzero uniformizer power is injective and its cokernel is the prescribed ideal quotient. Apply the exact single-complex functor and Mathlib mappingCone.quasiIso_descShortComplex to this short exact sequence. The cone terms are sums of the two rank-one or zero single terms, so they are finite free and vanish outside degrees -1 and 0.

For complete_iff, use the distinguished Roos triangle of completedRlim_roos. A Roos-complete input and the derived quotient limit are isomorphic: rotate both distinguished triangles, identify their common first arrow by identities, and lift the resulting shifted isomorphism. The constant-presentation transport identifies quotient completion and its specified unit with ConstantCompletion.completion. The koszul_quotient_reflector says its output is complete and its unit is invertible exactly on complete objects. Naturality makes unit invertibility invariant under isomorphism, so the input unit is invertible. Conversely, transport the canonical Roos triangle along that actual invertible unit. Countable products exist by exact countable products of pro-etale modules and the derived-countable-products theorem.

Convert the input Roos completeness by complete_iff. The existing AdicCoefficientDatum.push_complete gives TowerComplete of the ordinary direct image. Convert it back by complete_iff on the target. The existing finiteProjection_isIso and towerProjection_isIso give both projection isomorphisms. towerProjection_properties gives the exact finite evaluation equation and canonical completion composite identity. Since the direct-image completion unit and strict tower map are invertible, their composite after completedRlim is invertible. These declarations already implement perfect projection, strict-system compatibility and normalized augmentation; no reconstruction comparison in different coefficient coordinates is needed. Retain the ringed-tower pushforward-limit comparison import as required by the protected unit route; its normalized comparison underlies the existing direct-image API.

For the optional etale-origin clause, unfold only etaleComparisonInverse. The bounded-below comparison makes its defining mate invertible. The finite encoding component, direct image of theta.hom and the inverse comparison mate are all isomorphisms, hence their specified composite is an isomorphism.
